INSERT INTO elite_students (name, phone, belt_level, schedule_day, schedule_time, fee_per_class, remaining_classes, status)
SELECT s.name, s.phone, s.beltLevel, '星期日', '12:00-6:30pm', '0', 0, 'active'
FROM students s
WHERE s.name IN ('楊惜林', '曾祉媃', '吳博立', '歐航瑋', '葉栩靖', '葉駿輝', '吳芷媛', '李泳霖', '郭俊康', '張溰榆', '鄧穎翹', '黃天愉', '林慧玲', '黃煒庭', '林恩同', '韓灝南', '龐兆羽', '施俊杰', '李梓皓', '陳臻軒', '蔡宏鑫', '劉玥')
AND s.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM elite_students);
